items.title: Last day to file objection (Einspruch) against amended 2023 income tax assessment
items.quote: kann bis zum Ablauf eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch einlegen
items.computation: Letter dated 25.04.2025; assuming it was posted that day. Under § 122 Abs. 2 AO (as amended from 2025) the notice counts as given on the 4th day after posting: 29.04.2025 (Tuesday). One-month period (§ 355 AO, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) starts the following day and ends 29.05.2025. That is Ascension Day, a public holiday in Bremen, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the period ends on the next working day: Friday 30.05.2025.

The posting date is not stated; the deadline assumes the letter was posted on 25.04.2025, the letter date. If it was posted later, the deadline moves accordingly.
